READ	select typeof(true)

READ	select typeof(cast(1.0 as float)), typeof(1.0D), typeof(1.2)
READ	select typeof(date '1986-05-23'),  typeof(timestamp '1986-05-23'), typeof(interval '23 days')
READ	select typeof(x'ABCD'), typeof('SPARK')
READ	select typeof(array(1, 2)), typeof(map(1, 2)), typeof(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 'spark'))
READ	SELECT assert_true(true), assert_true(boolean(1))
READ	SELECT assert_true(false)
READ	SELECT assert_true(boolean(0))
READ	SELECT assert_true(null)
READ	SELECT assert_true(boolean(null))
READ	SELECT assert_true(false, 'custom error message')
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW tbl_misc AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1), (8), (2)) AS T(v)
READ	SELECT raise_error('error message')
READ	SELECT if(v > 5, raise_error('too big: ' || v), v + 1) FROM tbl_misc
READ	SELECT raise_error('error message', Map())
READ	SELECT raise_error('error message', 'some args')
READ	SELECT raise_error()
READ	SELECT raise_error(NULL)
READ	SELECT raise_error(1)

READ	SELECT assert_true(false)
READ	SELECT raise_error('hello')
SESSION	SET spark.sql.legacy.raiseErrorWithoutErrorClass=false
READ	SELECT assert_true(col1 <= col2) FROM VALUES ('2025-03-01', '2025-03-10')
